issues.explanation: The adaptation calls 单福 “徐庶” at the start of Chapter 36, before later presenting 曹操’s discovery that 单福 is 徐庶. This makes the subsequent identity reveal internally incoherent.
issues.suggested_fix: Use 单福 throughout the military campaign and only reveal his true name as 徐庶 when 程昱 identifies him to 曹操.
